question: Should capsule capture chmod an already-existing user-supplied --output directory to 0700, or preserve that output root while keeping generated sensitive files private?
rationale: The security goal supports private capsule artifacts, but chmoding an existing caller-selected directory changes local workspace permissions and needs maintainer intent before merge.

options.title: Preserve existing output roots
options.body: Keep 0600 generated files and private new/default capsule-owned directories, but do not chmod an already-existing user-supplied output root unless ownership is clearly established.

options.title: Accept strict directory repair
options.body: Document and test that reused output directories are deliberately chmoded to 0700, including explicit --output paths.

options.title: Pause for compatibility design
options.body: Hold the PR until a warning, doctor check, or migration story for broad existing capsule directories is defined.

recommendation.title: Preserve existing output roots
recommendation.body: Keep 0600 generated files and private new/default capsule-owned directories, but do not chmod an already-existing user-supplied output root unless ownership is clearly established.
